requirements.text: Place is a class representing the concept of a place in a Petri net
Transition is a class that represents the concept of a transition between places in a Petri net
Net is the class that represents the concept of a Petri net model
PTArc is a class tat represents that part of a transition that links incoming places to the transition symbol
TPArc is a class representing the part of a transition in a Petri net that links the transition symbol to the outgoing place(s) of the transition.
A petri net contains places and nets. Each place is associated to exactly one net.
Petri nets have Places and TPArcs. Places are in zero or more TPArcs
Each transition must be linked to exactly one Petri net to which it belongs.
Petri nets have transitions and TPArcs. Each transition has one or more TPArcs
Petri Nets have nets and places. Each net is composed by at least one place. This is, one or more places
Petri nets have PTArcs and Transitions. Each PTArc is associated to exactly one transition
In a Petri net, each TPArc has one source transition.
